description: Review working-tree and staged diffs with coding agents.
welcome:
No review comments yet.

Open a diff from Source Control, hover the gutter and click + to start a thread.

Agents read the same threads with `greview list --json`.
config.cliPath: Path to the `greview` executable. Empty means: look on `PATH`, then fall back to the copy bundled with this extension.
config.author: Name recorded on comments you write. Empty means git config user.name.
config.statusBar: Show the open-thread count in the status bar.
config.commentableLines: Where the gutter `+` appears in a diff: on any line, or only on lines that are part of the diff.
config.commentableLines.changedOnly: Only lines that are part of the diff
config.batchSubmit: Wait for an explicit **Submit review** before running this worktree’s submit hooks. Off by default: hooks run as soon as you write a comment, so an agent hears about each one immediately instead of only when you are finished.
